dedupe_keys.name: region ile de france rail datasets

description: Région Île-de-France: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Île-de-France. Coverage: Région Île-de-France. The listing groups 15 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Cartographie Open Street Map des gares Transilien; Gares du réseau ferré d'Île-de-France; Équipement des gares IDF; Liste des gares de voyageurs. Formats seen: CSV, JSON, XLS, SHP, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf), as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
